message: Hi, I'm a student with a r programming certification background. My overall academic average is 75.6% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in Software Engineering and cloud computing. I want to become a Technical Services/Help Desk/Tech Support. My family can afford at most about USD 13300 per year. I live in Chennai. I'm open to going abroad. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.
explanation:
This German program is highly recommended because it directly matches your interest in Tech Support/IT Operations and has a very low tuition fee ($450), making it affordable. Furthermore, the high placement rate (82%) and strong post-study work visa (18 months) maximize your chances of securing a good job abroad.

While focused on Business Information Systems, this German program offers excellent career prospects with a high median starting salary ($51k) and strong placement rate (82%). The low tuition fee ($300) keeps it within budget while providing valuable international experience.

This German MSc program provides a strong career path with excellent job prospects (91% placement rate and $56k salary). Although it focuses on IT Management rather than pure support, the low tuition ($950) and long post-study work visa (18 months) make it an ideal choice for maximizing employment opportunities.

This Dutch program is a good alternative if you prefer the Netherlands. While the tuition ($13300) is near your budget limit, it offers strong job security with a decent placement rate (77%) and a solid post-study work visa of 12 months.

This Dutch PG Diploma is specifically in Systems Administration/IT Support, directly aligning with your career goal. The tuition ($12800) is within budget, and the program offers a good post-study work visa (12 months), making it a practical choice for immediate job placement.
